Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 1 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of-life by the OEM before this period. 4. Generic --- Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 5. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 6. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 7. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components): Only supply of Goods 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses NOTE: 1. THE ITEM SHALL BE SUPPLIED AS PER THE ENCLOSED SPECIFICATION. 2. DELIVERY SCHEDULE: WITHIN 8 WEEKS (AS PER ATTACHMENT). 3. OFFERS MEETING THE MII CRITERIA WHICH IS MANDATORY, WILL ONLY BE CONSIDERED FOR R EVALUATION. PERCENTAGE OF MII CONTENT AND THE APPLICABLE MII CLASS SHALL BE MENTIONED IN THE OFFER. IN CASE ELIGIBLE FOR MSE/MII PREFERENCE, KINDLY ENSURE TO SUBMIT APPROPRIATE SUPPORTING DOCUMENTS. 4. QUANTITY TOLERANCE: I. FOR ORDER PLACEMENT: +/- 25% II. FOR SUPPLY: +/- 10% 5. ORDER SHALL BE PLACED ON SINGLE SOURCE. HOWEVER, QUANTITY IS DIVISIBLE IN CASE OF MSE/MII PREFERENCE. 6. THE BIDDER SHALL OFFER THE PRICE ON "F.O.R SALEM STEEL PLANT" BASIS IN GEM PORTAL INCLUDING P&F CHARGES, FREIGHT & INSURANCE CHARGES ETC WITH APPLICABLE TAXES & DUTIES. 7. PAYMENT TERMS: 100% WITHIN 30 DAYS AFTER RECEIPT AND ACCEPTANCE OF THE MATERIAL. KINDLY ACCEPT AND CONFIRM THE SAME IN YOUR OFFER. 8. THE PRICE SHALL BE KEPT FIRM TILL SUPPLIES ARE COMPLETED. 9. PRICE DISCOVERY SHALL BE THROUGH REVERSE AUCTION IN GEM. 10. KINDLY SUBMIT DULY FILLED-IN COPIES OF CONSOLIDATED UNDERTAKING, STATEMENT OF DEVIATION FROM SPECIFICATIONS AND BID TERMS AS PER THE ATTACHMENT, MII CERTIFICATE AND LAND BORDER SHARING DECLARATION. 11. KINDLY CONFIRM COMPLIANCE TOWARDS DOCUMENT SUBMISSION AS PER THE CHECK-LIS --- T ATTACHED. 12. KINDLY ACCEPT AND CONFIRM COMMERCIAL TERMS, GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS AND ALL OTHER TERMS OF THE RFQ BY SUBMITTING A SIGNED AND SEALED COPY OF THE RFQ DOCUMENT ALONG WITH THE ATTACHMENTS. 13. EMD OF ₹ 15,000/- IS APPLICABLE AS PER RFQ. HOWEVER, THE PARTIES CAN OPT TO SUBMIT BID SECURING DECLARATION. 14. THE SUCCESSFUL BIDDER SHOULD FURNISH SECURITY DEPOSIT FOR AN AMOUNT COVERING 3% (THREE PERCENT) OF THE ORDER VALUE OF THE CONTRACT WITHIN 15 (FIFTEEN) DAYS FROM THE DATE OF ORDER PLACEMENT. 15. IN CASE OF DELAY IN SUBMISSION OF SECURITY DEPOSIT, A PENALTY OF 0.2% OF THE ORIGINAL SD AMOUNT PER COMPLETED DAY OF DELAY, LIMITED TO AN AMOUNT NOT EXCEEDING 5% OF THE ORIGINAL SD AMOUNT SHALL BE APPLICABLE. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED AS PER THE ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA INCLUDING OEM/AUTHORISATION LETTER, GST CERTIFICATE, PAST PURCHASE ORDERS PROFIT & LOSS TURNOVER WITH VALID UDIN MENTIONED AND SELF DECLARATION SHALL BE SUBMITTED ALONG WITH THE OFFER. 18. IN SUCH INSTANCES, THE EXTRA COST INCURRED, IF ANY, WILL BE RECOVERED FROM THE DEFAULTING SUPPLIER. 19. BY PARTICIPATING IN THIS TENDER, THE SUPPLIERS/VENDORS/CUSTOMERS ARE DEEMED TO HAVE UNDERTAKEN THAT THEY SHALL NOT GIVE OR TAKE ANY FINANCIAL OR NON-FINANCIAL BRIBE, TO OR FROM ANYONE DURING THE TENDER OR DURING THE EXECUTION OF THE CONTRACT, THEREAFTER AND IF THEY NOTICE ANY SUCH INCIDENT HAPPENING, THEY SHALL REPORT TO SAIL VIGILANCE. 20. TENDERER'S WHO SUBMIT THEIR OFFERS SHALL BE DEEMED TO HAVE READ, UNDERSTOOD AND ACCEPTED THE TERMS & CONDITIONS OF THE TENDER DOCUMENT AND GENERAL COMMERCIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS FOR PURCHASE CONTRACT (SAIL-P1), GOVERNING PURCHASE CONTRACTS, I.E. SAIL-P1 AVAILABLE ON THE SAIL TENDER WEBSITE HTTPS://SAILTENDERS.CO.IN, BEING REVISED FROM TIME TO TIME. 21. SECURITY DEPOSIT: SECURITY DEPOSIT FOR AN AMOUNT COVERING 3% (THREE) OF THE BASIC VALUE (EXCLUDING TAXES, DUTIES & FREIGHT) OF THE CONTRACT, HAS TO BE SUBMITTED BY SUPPLIER WITHIN FIFTEEN DAYS (TWENTY ONE DAYS FOR OVERSEAS SUPPLIERS) OF THE DATE OF PURCHASE ORDER, SEPARATELY AT EACH OF THE SAIL UNITS FOR WHICH ORDERS ARE PLACED. a. SECURITY DEPOSIT CAN BE SUBMITTED EITHER IN THE FORM OF DEMAND DRAFT / PAY ORDER / BANKER'S CHEQUE OR BANK GUARANTEE ISSUED BY ANY SCHEDULED COMMERCIAL BANK OTHER THAN CO-OPERATIVE AND GRAMIN BANK. THE DEMAND DRAFTS/ PAY ORDER/ BANKER'S CHEQUE SHOULD BE PAYABLE AT THE RESPECTIVE SAIL UNIT. BGS SHOULD BE FROM BANKS HAVING BRANCH AT RESPECTIVE SAIL UNIT AND ENDORSED BY THE CORRESPONDING LOCAL BANK AT SAIL/SSP AS PER PERFORMA ENCLOSED. b. BANK GUARANTEE SHALL BE SUBMITTED AS PER PERFORMA ENCLOSED ALONG WITH THE TENDER. THE STAMP PAPER USED FOR THE BANK GUARANTEE SHALL BE OF THE APPROPRIATE VALUE AND SHOULD BE PURCHASED ON OR AFTER THE DATE OF PLACEMENT OF ORDER. THE STAMP PAPER USED FOR THE BANK GUARANTEE SHOULD BE PURCHASED ON BEHALF OF THE ISSUING BANK AND ISSUANCE OF AMENDMENT / EXTENSION OF BANK GUARANTEE SHOULD ALSO BE MADE ON STAMP PAPER O --- F APPROPRIATE VALUE PURCHASED IN THE NAME OF THE BANK. CONTACT DETAILS AND ADDRESS OF THE ISSUING BRANCH MUST BE AVAILABLE IN THE BANK GUARANTEE. c. IN CASE SECURITY DEPOSIT IS SUBMITTED IN THE FORM OF BANK GUARANTEE, THE N MANUFACTURER SHALL ENSURE THAT BANK GUARANTEE IS TO BE SUBMITTED BY THE ISSUING BANK DIRECTLY TO RESPECTIVE SAIL UNIT BY REGISTERED POST WITH A/D / COURIER MARKED TO CONTACT GIVEN IN PURCHASE ORDER. d. FAILURE FOR SUBMISSION OF SECURITY DEPOSIT: FAILURE TO SUBMIT SECURITY DEPOSIT WITHIN THE PERIOD SPECIFIED, WILL CONSTITUTE A BREACH OF THE CONTRACT AND PURCHASER SHALL BE ENTITLED TO FORFEIT THE EMD AND TO TAKE ALTERNATE PROCUREMENT ACTION AT THE RISK AND COST OF THE SUPPLIER. e. INTEREST-NO CLAIM SHALL LIE AGAINST SAIL/SSP EITHER IN RESPECT OF INTEREST ON SECURITY DEPOSIT OR DEPRECIATION IN VALUE. f. THE SECURITY DEPOSIT BANK GUARANTEE (SDBG) SHALL BE KEPT VALID AND IN FULL FORCE AND EFFECT TILL A PERIOD OF THREE MONTHS FROM THE DATE OF DELIVERY OF THE LAST CONSIGNMENT OF THE PURCHASE ORDER. THE SDBG SHALL BE OPERABLE AT THE LOCAL BRANCHES OF ISSUING BANK LOCATED AT THE RESPECTIVE SAIL PLANTS. g. RETURN OF BG -ON DUE PERFORMANCE AND COMPLETION OF THE CONTRACT IN ALL RESPECTS, SECURITY DEPOSIT SHALL BE RETURNED TO THE SUPPLIER WITHOUT ANY INTEREST. h. IN CASE THE SUPPLIER DELAYS SUBMISSION OF SECURITY DEPOSIT, A PENALTY OF 0.2% OF THE ORIGINAL SD AMOUNT PER COMPLETED DAY OF DELAY, LIMITED TO AN AMOUNT NOT EXCEEDING 5% OF THE ORIGINAL SD / PG AMOUNT SHALL BE APPLICABLE. PAYMENT FOR EXECUTED PORTION OF ORDER SHALL COMMENCE ON SUBMISSION OF REQUISITE SD.

atc_analysis.raw_markdown:
### 1. Standard Documents Required
* Experience Criteria
* Past Performance
* Bidder Turnover
* OEM Authorization Certificate
* OEM Annual Turnover

### 2. Clarified ATC Documents & Mandatory Uploads
* **Additional Doc 1**: Consolidated undertaking, Statement of deviation from specifications and bid terms, MII Certificate, Land border sharing declaration, Signed and sealed copy of the RFQ document
* **Financial Standing**: Undertaking confirming bidder is not under liquidation, court receivership, or bankruptcy
* **Product Data**: Data Sheet of the offered product(s)
* **Vendor Code Creation**: Copy of PAN Card, Copy of GSTIN, Copy of Cancelled Cheque, Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank
* **Eligibility Documents**: Profit & Loss Turnover with valid UDIN, Self-declaration

### 3. Exemption Documents Required
* **Proof for Exemption (MSEs)**: Udyam/MSE Registration Certificate (Inferred)
* **Proof for Exemption (Start-ups)**: DPIIT Startup Recognition Certificate (Inferred)

### 4. Physical Submissions (Offline)
* **Earnest Money Deposit (EMD)**: ₹ 15,000/- (or Bid Securing Declaration)
  * Deadline: With bid submission
  * In Favor Of: SAIL/SSP
  * Payable At: Salem
* **Security Deposit (SD)**: 3% of order value
  * Deadline: Within 15 days from date of order placement
  * In Favor Of: SAIL/SSP
  * Payable At: Salem

### 5. Key Commercial Terms & Conditions to Follow
* **Option Clause**: Purchaser reserves the right to increase/decrease quantity by 25% at contracted rates.
* **Pricing Basis**: F.O.R **SALEM STEEL PLANT** including P&F, freight, and insurance.
* **Payment Terms**: 100% within 30 days after receipt and acceptance of material.
* **Quantity Tolerance**: +/- 25% for order placement; +/- 10% for supply.
* **Reverse Auction**: Price discovery will be conducted via Reverse Auction in GeM.
* **Price Integrity**: Do not attach any price/price bid format in the technical offer; doing so will result in summary rejection.
* **MII Compliance**: Mandatory MII criteria; percentage of MII content and MII class must be mentioned in the offer.
* **Product Life**: Offered products must not be obsolete and must have at least 1 year of residual market life.
* **Security Deposit Penalty**: 0.2% of original SD amount per day of delay, capped at 5% of original SD amount.
* **Anti-Bribery**: Suppliers are prohibited from giving or taking bribes and must report incidents to SAIL Vigilance.
